source.active_destination: structured edit, normalized tree metadata, family fixtures, and private implementation helpers

portable_template_only_contracts.old_behavior: FileAlignerBase builds exact signature matches before adding template-only and destination-only entries.
portable_template_only_contracts.active_contract: Matched peers are established before template-only insertion decisions.

portable_template_only_contracts.old_behavior: Alignment sort keeps match and destination-only entries in destination order.
portable_template_only_contracts.active_contract: Destination-backed nodes retain destination order unless an explicit move/edit policy applies.

portable_template_only_contracts.old_behavior: Trailing groups anchor template-only runs to the previous matched template node, with a prefix group before the first match.
portable_template_only_contracts.active_contract: Template-only nodes are placed relative to matched template neighbors and language ordering policy.

portable_template_only_contracts.old_behavior: Interior groups flush only after all matched template indices through the group anchor have been consumed.
portable_template_only_contracts.active_contract: Destination reordering cannot cause premature insertion of a template-only group.

portable_template_only_contracts.old_behavior: Prefix groups are emitted before destination iteration; remaining groups are emitted by sorted anchor order after iteration.
portable_template_only_contracts.active_contract: Prefix and tail template-only groups have deterministic placement and reportable fallback basis.

portable_partial_template_contracts.active_contract: A partial template may target a selected region and merge only that region.
A partial template may target a structured key path and preserve the rest of the document.
Missing targets use explicit skip, append, prepend, or add policies and report the fallback.
Diff-to-node mapping belongs in reports/profiles and structured edit planning, not a public base class.
